condition: The proposal must be submitted as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC under REQ-0009.
event: The final document exceeds 20 pages during last-minute edits, or portal congestion delays the 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC upload.
effect: The proposal is disqualified instantly without review, losing the bid entirely.
assumptions: The team can finalize content well within the 20-page limit without last-minute overflow.
trigger: The draft reaches 18 pages one week before submission, or the portal is untested.
responses: Perform a dry-run upload via the procurement portal one week before the deadline.
residual_exposure: A technical outage of the procurement portal in the final hour before the deadline.

condition: The service must go live for students by 2027-01-11, leaving only 41 days from the submission deadline of 2026-12-01 to build, test, and integrate.
event: Integration complexities with the College's student records system REST API delay the go-live past 2027-01-11.
effect: The service fails to launch on the first day of spring enrollment, disrupting student registration.
assumptions: The College's existing REST API is fully documented and immediately accessible for testing.
trigger: API sandbox credentials are not provided within three days of contract award.
responses: Request API documentation and sandbox access prior to contract award.
Build a mock API server to enable parallel frontend and backend integration testing.
residual_exposure: Undocumented rate limits or unexpected authentication quirks in the College's live REST API.

condition: Migration of signed records held in the current tool is scheduled as a should requirement (REQ-0017) by 2027-02-28, while ten-year document storage (REQ-0016) is mandatory.
event: Resources are pulled away from migration to handle spring enrollment support, causing migration to slip past 2027-02-28.
effect: Historical signed records remain trapped in the legacy tool, complicating audits and ten-year retention compliance.
assumptions: Legacy data export formats are compatible with the new ingestion pipeline.
trigger: Migration script development is delayed past 2027-01-15 due to enrollment support priorities.
responses: Allocate dedicated data engineering resources separate from the core go-live delivery team.
Define a prioritized batch migration schedule starting with the most recent records.
residual_exposure: Incomplete legacy records requiring manual data cleanup and exception handling.
